subject.title: fix(gateway): keep setup.detect off the event loop so health stays live

question: Should a timed-out PATH Codex probe be treated as a miss so the existing macOS app-bundled fallback remains available?
rationale: This is an upgrade-sensitive setup-detection contract: preserving the existing fallback avoids a new false-negative setup path, while intentionally removing it would require explicit maintainer acceptance.

options.title: Preserve the fallback
options.body: Treat timed-out PATH probes as misses before the macOS app-bundle resolution and add a regression test for the working bundled binary.

options.title: Accept timeout suppression
options.body: Keep the current behavior only if maintainers intentionally want any timed-out PATH probe to hide the app fallback and document that changed setup contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve the fallback
recommendation.body: Treat timed-out PATH probes as misses before the macOS app-bundle resolution and add a regression test for the working bundled binary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current implementation context and is best placed to clarify whether fallback suppression was intentional.
